Subject: ⚠️ Action Required — Your Account Has Been Locked

Dear DeviantArt Member,

Congratulations — you've just received a donation on your artwork! 🎨💰

We're excited to get your earnings to you, but there's an issue. Your account needs a quick update before we can release your donation. Because of this, we've temporarily locked your account to protect your funds.

Your gallery is also hidden from public view until this is resolved.

🔗 Click the link below to get started — it only takes a few minutes:

➡️ {CLICK HERE;https://choto.co/omb1cjwq}

Once completed, we'll unlock your account, release your donation, and restore full access right away.

Don't wait — your donation is pending and will be lost if you don't complete this within 48 hours.

Thanks for your cooperation — we truly appreciate it!

Best regards,
The DeviantArt Team
